content_sections.heading: JNPA General Manager (Finance) Recruitment 2026 - Overview
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

rows.jawaharlal_nehru_port_authority_jnpa_nav: Jawaharlal Nehru Port Authority, Sheva, Navi Mumbai

Officers of Major Port Authorities holding posts in the pay scale of Rs. 80000-220000 with three years regular service in the Finance Department of a Major Port Trust; essential qualification as per Schedule: Member of Institute of Chartered Accountants of India or of Institute of Cost and Works Accountants of India.
Upper age limit of 45 years is for direct recruitment and does not apply to absorption as per the enclosed Schedule; eligibility date 1 July 2027 (as on 1 July 2027)

content_sections.heading: JNPA Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. A/P/E/A-09/2026/1880 gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download JNPA notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Member of Institute of Chartered Accountants of India or of Institute of Cost and Works Accountants of India; for absorption, officers holding posts in the scale of pay of Rs. 80000-220000 with three years regular service in the Finance Department of a Major Port Trust. Experience: For absorption through the composite method: officers holding posts in the scale of pay of Rs. 80000-220000 with three years regular service in the Finance Department of a Major Port Trust Age limit: Upper age limit of 45 years is for direct recruitment and does not apply to absorption as per the enclosed Schedule; eligibility date 1 July 2027 (as on 1 July 2027) Other conditions: Applicant must be an officer of a Major Port Authority Application must be forwarded with prior approval of the Competent Authority of the applicant's Port

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for JNPA Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Applications submitted through any mode other than OAP Incomplete applications or those received after the prescribed time limit

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Post falls vacant on a regular basis with effect from 1 July 2027 Selected officer to be relieved from present post within 30 days from date of appointment Withdrawal after selection by the Service Selection Committee makes the official liable to two years' debarment from Head of Department-level posts in all Major Port Authorities

content_sections.heading: How Will JNPA Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Selection by merit by the Service Selection Committee, with the benchmark in overall grading in the ACRs not below Very Good Selection is by merit; benchmark in overall grading in the ACRs will not be below Very Good

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Attested photocopies of ACRs/APARs for the last five years, each page attested by an officer not below Head of Department rank Proforma with attested copies of certificates of educational and other qualifications (Annexure II) Undertaking from the applicant in the prescribed format (Annexure III) Administrative and Vigilance Clearance in the prescribed format (Annexure IV)

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for JNPA Recruitment 2026 Online
content_sections.text: Eligible officers submit the application through the Online Application Portal (OAP) of the Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways at http://onlinevacancy.shipmin.nic.in. Applications submitted through any other mode will not be accepted. Send a hard copy of the OAP application, duly forwarded through the proper channel, with the listed documents. Envelope must be superscribed 'Application for the post of General Manager (Finance) in JNPA'. Address: The General Manager (Administration) & Secretary, Jawaharlal Nehru Port Authority, Administration Building, Sheva, Navi Mumbai - 400 707. Application and supporting documents must reach JNPA on or before 18 December 2026.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: If an advance copy is received, candidature is considered only if the forwarded application reaches JNPA within 15 days from the closing date JNPA is not responsible for any postal, technical or other delay Method: absorption through composite method, failing which deputation, failing both direct recruitment

faq.answer: Officers of Major Port Authorities holding posts in the pay scale of Rs. 80000-220000 with three years regular service in the Finance Department of a Major Port Trust; essential qualification as per Schedule: Member of Institute of Chartered Accountants of India or of Institute of Cost and Works Accountants of India.

faq.question: Q6. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Applicant must be an officer of a Major Port Authority. Application must be forwarded with prior approval of the Competent Authority of the applicant's Port.

faq.answer: Applications submitted through any mode other than OAP. Incomplete applications or those received after the prescribed time limit.
